finding.rationale: A member account's password alone yielded a delegated Graph token through ROPC (R017: token_event flow=ropc, success). ROPC cannot satisfy MFA, so a Conditional Access policy that requires MFA for all users on all resources makes this sign-in fail instead of issuing a token. Microsoft recommends that baseline for every tenant; the guest-only policy previously mapped here (CA-SIG003-Guests-RequireMFA) does not cover member accounts. Exclusions should be limited to emergency-access accounts, and any user account used for automation should move to a workload identity.

control.control_id: CA-RequireMFA-AllUsers (Require MFA for all users, all resources)
